character.name: Juno
character.role: Example character, not a real person

title.sub: A drawn character, voiced and animated on one computer.

lines.say: Hi, I'm Juno. I'm a drawing, not a real person, and my voice is computer-generated.
This video started from one portrait and a short script.
The portrait became a simple 3D head, and my mouth opens with the loudness of the voice.
Blinks and nods come from a seed, so every frame renders the *same* way each time.

points.text: The same frames on every run
